originalTitle: US battery energy storage doubles over 2025–2029?
title: 美国并网电池储能能量会在 2029 年底达到 260 GWh 吗？
Will US grid-connected battery energy reach 260 GWh by end-2029?
rules: 原题固定 2025 基线为 130 GWh，要求截至 2029-12-31 的并网电化学储能 ≥260 GWh，涵盖选定统计里的公用事业、工商和住宅；优先使用统一全国能量序列。
The contract fixes a 130 GWh 2025 baseline and requires ≥260 GWh by 2029-12-31 across the selected national series, including utility, commercial and residential segments.
interpretation: 130 GWh 是创建者固定的判定常数，不根据事后 2025 实际统计调整；GW 功率不能替代此 GWh 能量。
130 GWh is a fixed rule constant, not revised to match ex-post 2025 statistics; GW power cannot substitute for GWh.

summary: 本题实际门槛为 260 GWh，标题的“翻倍”相对于规则固定值。统计覆盖与能量单位比字面增速更重要。
The actual threshold is 260 GWh; “doubling” refers to a fixed rule baseline. Coverage and energy units matter more than the headline growth wording.
checklist: 使用能量 MWh/GWh，而非功率 MW/GW。
Use energy MWh/GWh, not power MW/GW.
保持部门、地理和修订版本一致。
Keep sector, geography and revisions consistent.
按容量参考日期而非出版日期核对截止。
Use capacity reference date, not publication date.

stage: 材料与试验 → 产品验证 → 实际应用
Materials and tests → product verification → application
impact: EIA 公用事业级功率数据说明部署背景，却不覆盖此题所有部门和能量指标。项目清单与行业全国序列需要统一，不能靠把不同来源各自总量相加来补齐 260 GWh。
EIA utility power provides context but not the all-sector energy series. Project and national statistics need alignment; totals from differing sources cannot simply be added to reach 260 GWh.
gap: 优先全国统一序列；原题基线不标为已核实测量。
Use a consistent national series; the baseline is not a verified measurement.

title: 电池储能的 GW 与 GWh
Battery storage in GW and GWh
principle: 电堆或变流器限制功率，电极或电解液总量影响能量。并网储能统计还需区分公用事业级与住宅工商等范围，不能把功率与能量相加。
Stacks and converters limit power while electrode or electrolyte inventory affects energy. Statistics distinguish utility and distributed sectors; power and energy are not additive.
example: EIA 记录的超过 26 GW 是公用事业级功率，市场 260 GWh 则是多部门能量阈值，原题固定的 130 GWh 只作为规则常数显示。
EIA’s over 26 GW measures utility-scale power; the market’s 260 GWh is a multisector energy threshold, with 130 GWh retained solely as a rule constant.

label: 参与较少
Few participants
detail: 概率来自少量参与者；查看成交数量与原始规则。
Few participants contribute; review activity and source rules.
